blocks.content:
Review round addressed. Summary of this turn:

- **CI**: first run was green (2/2 checks, including the required "iOS Build & Test").
- **Review comments**: the Augment bot filed 3 valid comments. All fixed in commit c7d8e9f on [intent-hq/ios#120](https://github.com/intent-hq/ios/pull/120):
  1. User-row copy now uses `userSampleText`, restricted to the text blocks the row actually renders — code/file blocks in user payloads can no longer leak into copies.
  2. Assistant-row copy now cleans each text block with the same `SampleBlockView.stripSamplePrompts` used for rendering (made `static` to share it), so suggested-prompts blocks, HTML comments, `<agent_digest>` and supervisor tags are removed.
  3. Assistant-row copy is built from the `groupContentBlocks` display pipeline, so `<group:…>` tags never appear in copied text.
- Added 5 tests covering the new helpers, replied to each review comment with the fix, and resolved all 3 threads.

The PR monitor remains active and will wake me when CI settles on c7d8e9f; I'll confirm green and mark the task complete then. Not merging — that stays with a human.
